# The Way of the Test

A short sample used by LinguaLeaf's API seam tests and manual demos.

## Chapter One: Red

Mr. Gupta woke early. The morning was quiet, and the sea was calm.

He wrote a failing test first. Then he made it pass!

## Chapter Two: Green

### Interlude: The Command

Run the whole suite with:

```bash
npm test -- --filter core
```

Reading more: [the official handbook](https://example.com/handbook). It is free.

## Chapter Three: Evidence

The community kept three rules:

- Write the failing test first.
- Refactor with the suite green.
- Keep the list short.

> A test that passes the moment it is written has told you nothing. It merely
> records the code as it is.
